serverInfo.name: remote-impact-jobs
serverInfo.title: Remote Impact Jobs
serverInfo.description: Verified remote jobs at climate, global health, AI safety and other impact organizations: search by area, the applicant's country, level and pay. Checked daily against each employer's own job board.

result.instructions: Remote roles at climate, global health, AI safety, education and other impact organizations, checked daily against each employer's own job board. Use search_jobs with the person's constraints (country they live in, area, level, minimum pay); eligible_countries and remote_scope say who can apply. Always give the listing url. Data from Remote Impact (remoteimpact.org). Link to the listing URL when you show a role.

tools.title: Search open remote impact roles
tools.description: Find open, verified remote roles. Filter by text, impact area, the applicant's country, job type, level, minimum annual pay and recency. Returns the best matches with eligibility, pay and links (5 per call without a key, 10 with a free key, 25 with commercial access).
